script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying Ethan looks up adds an action the psalm does not describe.
The kitchen-schedule comparison does not connect clearly to the enduring oath. It makes the sacred promise the setup for a joke without a clear payoff.
The line about God chasing waves makes God's action the subject of a joke and adds an image the psalm does not give.
The joke about a cookie tray making noise on a shelf has no clear logic or connection to the mountains shouting for joy.
The promise says no enemy will exact tribute from David. Saying nobody gets to send him a bill broadens it beyond that promise.
The moon does not necessarily show up visibly every day. The psalm does not make that claim.
